more_info.overview: Potassium silicate is an inorganic silicate preparation containing potassium and silicon-oxygen components. Different potassium-to-silica proportions can occur in materials described by this broad name. This historical dataset entry gives it an anti-caking classification. The reviewed general description does not establish a specific food-grade composition or typical human-food use. Its industrial applications are a separate context.
